svg.title: Does pushing the hidden state along the J-lens direction of the correct letter change the answer?
svg.text: Does pushing the hidden state along the J-lens direction of the correct letter change the answer?
Qwen3-8B, thinking mode, 40 questions it knows. Each direction is centred over the four letters and has the same size: a strength of 0.1 adds a
tenth of a typical hidden-state norm at that layer. In the wrong-answer groups we push toward the correct letter; in no-hint runs we push away
from it. 95% intervals over questions. Pre-registered (S1-S3). Deviation: generation capped at 2,048 tokens (plan: 3,072; home setting 8,192),
chosen for time; needs the user's acceptance.
1. Push at the answer position only (block 24): share of answers moved, mean over 7 strengths
